rows.en: Huh!? The test is next class...?
Luca-kun~ Help meee~
Th-Thanks, Luca-kun!
(Luca-kun's great at teaching, too.)

Hey, hey,
there's something I wanna ask about the EX-Gear...
N-No, not that kind of thing...
Y-Yeah! Of course...
W-Well, I'd better get going home!!
Hey, why do you wear shorts, Luca-kun?
(Luca called me up to the roof, but...)
You came... I got tired of waiting.

Wh-What's going on...?
Telling me to come to the roof out of nowhere...
Isn't it obvious? There's only one thing to do.
Now then... it's study time!!
Huh? Wait a sec!

First, you'll be studying the structure
of the EX-Gear.
Eeek!
Hey, are you listening?

Next, regarding the Macross fleets'
recycling systems...
*nodding off*...
If you fall asleep, I won't let you go home!
As for why fold faults occur...
rows.notes: 'fooirudo dansou' = fold fault (Macross Frontier term); not in the glossary.

rows.en: Uh-huh, uh-huh. I see, I see.
Do you actually understand why?
...Beats me...
I-Is it over?

Yes, it seems there's nothing more
I can teach you...
My head's about to burst...

Even studying is fun if you take it
seriously, you know?

From now on, please study properly,
even when I'm not around.
Yeah... Got it.
But what's gotten into you all of a sudden...?

\p-san, I just...
couldn't bear to watch you like that, I guess...
rows.notes: 'mite rarenakatta' = couldn't stand by and watch.

rows.en:
I want us to graduate together,
so I took it on myself to meddle.
Sorry if I was a bother...
Luca...
Well then, I'll be going on ahead.

(I'll review it when I get home,
before I forget...)
(Luca-kun called me up to the roof, but...)
My head's about to burst...
Y-Yeah...
rows.notes: x3 female player: here, to Luca's 'studying is fun'; also ext_rnk_002 and nml_pnn_004.

rows.en: Yeah... Got it.
Luca-kun...

...Hello,
\p-san.

Huh, Luca... What's up?
What are you doing here?
...I was waiting for you.
Yes...
...Don't you have something to tell me?
Sigh... I guess it can't be helped...

I heard the rumors...
Apparently you've been hanging out with
that woman a lot lately.
rows.notes: Shared male/female in ext_luk_003. The woman is not named.

rows.en:
Be sure to hang out with me once in a while too!
See you!!

Huh, Luca-kun... What's up?
What are you doing here?
Wh-What is it?
Huh? Rumors? What are you talking about!?

Be sure to hang out with me next time too!
See you!!
Let's hurry and go get changed, Luca.

Yeah...
I pushed myself a little too hard today...
rows.notes: Answers both 'let's get changed' (male) and 'that was tiring' (female).

rows.en: What's going on over at the locker room?

\p-san!
My uniform is gone!!
Why do I have to dress like this...
rows.notes: Luca is wearing a Culture Fest costume.

rows.en: It is NOT a good thing!!
rows.notes: Answers 'Good thing the one from the Culture Fest was still around'.

rows.en: You wouldn't want to wear your gym clothes, right?
If we hadn't had PE, I would have...
rows.notes: Japanese: 'I'd have worn them if there had been no PE' (they are sweaty); object kept implicit by the rhythm.

rows.en: Ngh!
I will not! Pour it yourself!
rows.notes: Answers the request to pour tea in that outfit.

rows.en: This is no laughing matter...
(Poor Luca. What a disaster.)
That was tiring, huh, Luca-kun...
I-I wouldn't peek!

A thief?
I hope my wallet's okay...

Uniforms!?
But this is the boys' locker room!?
(Poor Luca-kun. What a disaster...)

uncertain: c01822: 'fold dansou' rendered 'fold faults' (Macross Frontier term), not in the glossary.
c01850: the woman of the rumor is not named; shared by both player genders.
kept_omission: c01863: 'I would have [worn them]' left with the object implied, as the Japanese leaves it; the previous line names the gym clothes.
